A major Test cricket contest awaits as Pakistan welcome Sri Lanka to Rawalpindi for the first Test of their 2026 tour.
Pakistan have a strong batting group featuring Babar Azam, Saud Shakeel, Salman Agha and Sameer Minhas, while their bowling options include Mohammad Abbas, Aamer Jamal and Saqib Khan.
Sri Lanka bring an experienced group led by Kusal Mendis, with Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva, Kamindu Mendis and Prabath Jayasuriya among the notable names.
